experiences.title: Business and Marketing Analyst
experiences.description:

Reduced reporting turnaround by 25% by leading stakeholder JAD sessions to align cross-functional teams on KPI definitions, then translating agreed requirements into Power BI report specifications that connected performance trends directly to management decisions.
Improved analytics infrastructure efficiency by 30% by auditing data sources for gaps, documenting lineage and reporting logic to ensure accurate, traceable dashboards — directly supporting leadership decision-making and compliance reporting.
